name: Activity List
purpose: Defines all the activities needed to complete the project work, described in enough detail that the person doing the work understands what is required to do it correctly. It contains an activity identifier, an activity name and a description of the work.

elements.guidance: A brief statement that summarizes the activity; it usually starts with a verb and is only a few words.
If needed, more detail on the activity, such as the process or method used to do the work.

tailoring: For some projects, enter the activities in the scheduling tool instead of keeping a separate activity list.
Not every project needs a column describing the work.
For an adaptive development approach, the activity list evolves as requirements are added or changed in the product backlog.
For an adaptive approach, consider adding a column for the planned release or iteration of each activity.
agile_or_adaptive: For adaptive approaches, or progressively elaborated projects, activities are defined throughout the project; the list evolves as the product backlog changes, and a release or iteration column can be added (PDF pages 70 to 71, printed pages 59 to 60).
